checks.subject: Licensed starting article
checks.finding: The official Purple Book independently confirms Zemaira, BLA 125078, 351(a), intravenous 1 g/4 g/5 g single-dose presentations and original approval on 8 July 2003. The pair does not convert this biologic precedent into a generic-drug asset, an automatically available 505(b)(2) pathway, sponsor data-reliance permission or an approved EVLP product.

checks.subject: Label versus warm process
checks.finding: The independently read January 2024 prescribing information supplies the labeled IV use and three-hour post-reconstitution administration direction. The pair treats warm EVLP compatibility and functional potency as unqualified without claiming the label proves immediate inactivation or harm in the research mixture.

checks.subject: US publication and current-status ceiling
checks.finding: The identified US A1 publication is kept separate from a granted US right. The pair records 70 numbered positions with cancellations and broad application claims without presenting them as enforceable granted scope. Pending and conflicting abandonment hints remain unresolved because readable current official prosecution/title records were not recovered. No freedom-to-operate inference is made.

checks.subject: AU original claim version
checks.finding: The original AU B2 front and screenshots of PDF pages 49 and 53 independently confirm the accepted-journal date of 4 January 2024, claims 1 and 2 for human-lung normothermic perfusion for 6–12 hours with 8–12 mg/mL AAT, claim 2 adding transplantation, and a final claim 22. The pair does not substitute the broad US application or the erroneous HTML claim-count header for this version.

checks.subject: KR original count and translation limit
checks.finding: The KR original front independently confirms registration on 16 June 2022, publication on 22 June 2022 and 58 total claims. The original claim page and explicitly machine-translated rendering support the ventilated normothermic lung-perfusion description. Numbered positions with deletions are not represented as 70 surviving claims. No independent legal translation or current maintenance opinion is asserted.

checks.subject: Inherited foreign-grant existence
checks.finding: Round2 AAT text was independently checked and already lists related AU/KR grants. The reviewed pair correctly labels Round22 as newly inspecting claim versions/counting detail rather than newly discovering grant existence or erasing prior provenance.

checks.subject: Trial metadata is not ex-vivo efficacy
checks.finding: The official Canadian portal independently matches UHN protocol 23-5745/control 294199, Zemaira, a displayed Not yet recruiting status, 18 July 2026 update, 27 February 2025 trial authorization/no-objection date, Other phase and no registry match. The pair does not infer EVLP-only administration, completed enrollment, outcomes or marketing approval from this summary.

checks.subject: Proposed patent clinical use
checks.finding: The US application clinical example and five-donor research pilot remain separate. Optional recipient IV dosing in a proposed transplantation example does not become a completed ex-vivo-only transplant result or a clinical product authorization.

checks.subject: Platform-specific regulatory context
checks.finding: FDA P180014 independently identifies the XPS/STEEN workflow for reassessing initially unacceptable lungs and explicitly warns that supplements can change labeling. S014 independently confirms a September 2026 lung-cannula luer-cap supplier/material change. The pair does not call these AAT approvals; the manufacturer five-hour description remains configuration-specific rather than a universal legal limit or complete current-label audit.

checks.subject: Original marginal-dollar tranche
checks.finding: The original authored cost/rank record was independently read and its hash matched. AAT is seventh in that independent ranking, with an illustrative US$30–100k over 2–4 months for initial formulation/potency/process qualification, excluding scarce organs and transplant validation. Qualification is therefore the original priced information tranche; the pair correctly avoids importing the different P2 scope objection. The envelope remains unquoted and unauthorized.

checks.subject: Incremental value without circular prerequisites
checks.finding: Scientific usefulness, a useful process/product and privately retained value remain separate questions. A formulation contribution or retained local AAT can support a practical benefit even without a uniquely proved dual-protease mechanism. Final commercial licenses and completed transplantation validation are not required before any informative qualification can be valued. The pair instead keeps later useful-graft relevance, affordable informative qualification and a credible capture route conditional.

checks.subject: Bounded decision and restrictions
checks.finding: The pair stays within the existing AAT program. It claims no numerical EV, new portfolio allocation, acquired material, partner agreement, secured ownership or executable experimental order. Reopening depends on concrete decision-changing evidence; waiting remains an option. All six prohibited activity flags are false.

checks.subject: Machine-readable evidence graph
checks.finding: Strict JSON parsing found no duplicate keys or non-finite constants. All 16 evidence rows resolve to the 11 public sources or four local inputs, and all nine claim decisions resolve to evidence rows. All four local input SHA256 values match the files read. Source-access limitations are retained rather than filled by inference.

checks.subject: Final version binding
checks.finding: The Markdown and complete JSON were read and hashed from bytes after review. The two reviewed file entries bind intended repository paths, byte lengths and SHA256 values. The reviewer did not edit either authored file.
